title: MLS deep system audit #2 — prop calibration, dispersion, invariants, security

MAJOR_FINDING_goal_dispersion.issue: GOAL_DISPERSION_CV=0.30 is a WC26-sourced constant that the MLS model inherited. Widening the goal spread inflates P(0 goals) per side, which suppresses BTTS and the overs.
MAJOR_FINDING_goal_dispersion.mechanism: at lam 1.72/1.55, cv 0.30 raises P(home=0) 18.0%->20.2% and P(away=0) 21.2%->23.3%, dropping BTTS 64.6%->61.2%; mean total is unchanged (mean-1 multipliers), only the SHAPE moves
MAJOR_FINDING_goal_dispersion.fix: config.MLS_GOAL_DISPERSION_CV=0.0, injected per-simulator; WC26 keeps GOAL_DISPERSION_CV=0.30 so the archive replays bit-for-bit. Engine signature now records the MLS value (replay reads it).
MAJOR_FINDING_goal_dispersion.note: monotonic in cv and mechanistically explained; still in-sample tuned like every other parameter here

FINDING_props_correctly_excluded_from_ca.question: the 3-way is calibrated (shrunk toward uniform) but 50 of 53 markets are raw — is that a bug?
FINDING_props_correctly_excluded_from_ca.answer: NO. Measured: props are slightly UNDER-confident (bias -2 to -6pp), and shrinking them toward 0.5 makes log-loss monotonically WORSE (0.588 -> 0.604). Excluding props from calibration is correct.
FINDING_props_correctly_excluded_from_ca.residual: displayed scorelines (raw) disagree with the displayed 3-way (calibrated) by 3-9pp; a display-coherence issue, not a wrong number — the gap tracks the calibration formula to within 0.01

lambda_bias: predicted mean total 3.264 vs actual 3.438 (-0.174/match). A leak-free multiplicative correction was tested and REJECTED: it fixes the mean but overshoots over2.5 (-0.0083) and slightly hurts the 3-way.

passed.replay: v5 artifacts replay the calibration and legacy v4 artifacts still replay their frozen win% prior exactly — historical locks reproduce byte-for-byte
passed.money_lock: code-level: approved_for_real_money never set anywhere; NO order-placement path exists; paper.py makes zero HTTP calls
passed.security: all 3 admin endpoints reject no-token and bad-token with 403; storage endpoint leaks no secrets
passed.paper_fees: Kalshi fee formula exact to the centicent across 2000 fuzzed orders + edge cases (P=0,1; C=0,negative)
passed.datetimes: no unnormalised datetime comparisons in live code; no implausible kickoffs
passed.probability_invariants: 3-way sums to 1; margin nesting, totals monotonicity, team-total monotonicity, first-goal partition all hold across 16 fixtures
passed.silent_handlers: 82 inventoried; the 6 live-plane write-path handlers all report upward (the one that did not caused the Jul 25 DiskFull incident and was fixed)
